# polaris_principal (Resource)

Manages an Apache Polaris principal identity and its client credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_principal" "data_engineer" {
  name = "john_engineer"

  properties = {
    email      = "john.engineer@company.com"
    department = "data-platform"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique username of the Polaris principal.

### Optional

- `credential_rotation_required` (Boolean) Whether initial credentials must be immediately rotated upon first use.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties associated with this principal.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID generated by Polaris for this principal.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret generated by Polaris upon principal creation.
- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter for optimistic concurrency.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
